records.title: Consilience for Verifier-Free Test-Time Scaling
records.reason: Consilience selects verifier-free reasoning rollouts by penalizing high initial confidence and requiring high final confidence; math/code tasks show quality gains over confidence-only baselines. The method performs test-time branching/selection and does not claim lower total inference compute.

records.title: SCOUT: Self-Checking and Recovery-Aware Tool-Thought Agents for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning
records.reason: SCOUT combines recovery-aware tool selection with uncertainty-prioritized policy optimization for ultra-long egocentric video. It reports benchmark quality gains but adds iterative tool interactions and supplies no latency/token/compute saving; efficiency trade-offs remain unmeasured.

records.title: Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence
records.reason: The paper defines persistent visual memory, context selection, layered indexes, and source-grounded evidence for continuously arriving video. Retrieval results are strong, but the contribution is an infrastructure/system model rather than a measured LLM inference-cost optimization.
